# Molecular Transformer checkpoint

Model weights are not redistributed with this archive.

Download `STEREO_separated_augm_model_average_20.pt` from:

<https://ibm.ent.box.com/v/MolecularTransformerModels>

Place the downloaded file in this directory without renaming it. The resulting
relative path must be:

```text
third_party/MolecularTransformer/experiments/models/STEREO_separated_augm_model_average_20.pt
```

Expected SHA-256:

```text
456d1027bf186945d394de17ab325046e3034e71c7ca93c4c735ad9a8b0dc8c3
```
